info.title: Lebanese University Connect API
info.description:
REST API for Lebanese University Connect (LUC): Q&A feed, communities, alumni verification, mentorship, courses, moderation, and admin tools.

Most write endpoints require a Keycloak JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Admin routes under `/api/admin/**` require the `ADMIN` role. Public GETs (feed, questions, communities, courses, alumni directory, health) do not require auth; sending a token may still enrich responses (e.g. viewer vote).
